data.name: Awwak
data.gender_notes: Awwak is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'awa', meaning 'to love'. This name signifies a gentle and loving soul. The name Awwak carries the meaning “Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awwak usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine love and kindness.
data.etymology: Awwak belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awwak total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
